note: Brand and claims rules for Outdoor Norway scripts. Derived from the company's brand voice and guest benefit checks and the content QC rules. Swap this file to reuse the skill for another brand. Matching is case-insensitive. Severity: block fails the script, warn is reported.

rules.message: Greeting or channel intro opens the script. Open on the guest's stake instead.
End signal before the payoff, or a generic sign-off. End on the payoff and one call to action.
Cliche or exaggeration the brand voice rejects. Name the thing instead.
Scarcity or urgency wording. Use real departure dates from the facts table instead.
Negative framing of an activity or difficulty. Describe what the day involves instead.
Company-speak or third person. Speak to the guest with you, use we for what the team looks after.
Sales verb. A script should help first and sell once, in the call to action.
Personal-attribute address. Meta and good taste both dislike it. Describe the trip, not the viewer.

Guarantee wording attached to a natural phenomenon. The aurora, snow, powder, weather and wildlife can never be promised. Only a negation that directly governs the guarantee word (can't promise, no guarantee, not guaranteed) makes it safe.
rules.regex: \b(guarante\w*|promise[sd]?|always|100 ?%|for sure|definitely|certain(ly)?|sure thing|no question|no doubt|without fail|not a chance|never miss|won't miss|will not miss)[^.!?]{0,60}\b(aurora|northern lights|snow|powder|weather|sunshine|sighting|wildlife|whales?|reindeer)\b|\b(aurora|northern lights|snow|powder|weather|sunshine|sighting|wildlife|whales?|reindeer)\b[^.!?]{0,60}\b(guarante\w*|promise[sd]?|always|100 ?%|for sure|definitely|certain(ly)?|sure thing|no question|no doubt|without fail|not a chance|never miss|won't miss|will not miss|every (day|night|morning|week|weekend|winter|time|trip))
rules.guarantee_regex: \b(guarante\w*|promise[sd]?|always|100 ?%|for sure|definitely|certain(ly)?|sure thing|no question|no doubt|without fail|not a chance|never miss|won't miss|will not miss|every (day|night|morning|week|weekend|winter|time|trip))
rules.negated_when_preceded_by: (\b(can't|cannot|can not|won't|will not|doesn't|does not|don't|do not|isn't|is not|aren't|are not|never|not|no)|\b(no one|nobody|no \w+) can)( (ever|always|really))?\s*$

rules.message: The script sells the northern lights or a sighting but never says the aurora cannot be promised. Add a possibility line.
rules.requires_regex: (can't|cannot|can not|no one can|nobody can|no tour can|no trip can|no departure can|no guide can|we can't|we cannot) (promise|guarantee)|no guarantee|not guaranteed|never guaranteed|if the sky|if the clouds|if the lights|(a|some|good|fair|real) chance (of|to) (see|seeing|catch|catching|spot|spotting)|depends on the sky|when the sky|may show|might show|could show

rules.message: Unsupported superlative. Cite, in the same beat's facts column, a sourced row that contains the same word, or use a plain description.

Possible exclusivity claim (the only, the most, the first). If it is a claim, cite a sourced row with the same words in that beat. Ordinary use such as 'your first tour' or 'lesson first' is not flagged.
A date without a year. State the year at least once in the script.
A placeholder is still in the spoken line or the on-screen text. Resolve it with the client or cut the claim.

cta.note: C03 warns when a cta beat uses more than one of these verbs (stacked asks). C01 warns when a beat without the cta or soft-cta role matches untagged_regex.
cta.untagged_regex: \b(book (now|today|your|a|the|it|online|here|from|via|at)|subscribe|link below|link in (the )?bio|tap the link|click the link|sign up)\b

place_names.note: Sentence-initial words are not counted as names unless they are here, or appear mid-sentence with a capital in the facts table or the script.

guest_subject.note: The guest is the subject. The hook window must address the guest.

difficulty_note: Describe difficulty by what the day involves (long ascents, steep descents, confident on skis), never with adjectives or warnings.
